description: Analyze the codebase and refactor to proper domain boundaries with a lean gateway acting purely as a translation/orchestration layer over gRPC; consolidate duplicate code, fix cross-codebase inconsistencies, and remove dead code judged against active product need. Audit-first: Phase 1 produces a dispositioned findings report; later phases execute approved, behavior-preserving changes in small green-gated batches (contract evolution allowed with snapshot+docs in the same batch).
